name: agent-quiet
description: Quiet agents, each way: a silent agent, one that ended its turn without a report, and one back from a usage limit are nudged while nudges last, left alone while a nudge is on its way, handed to a person in manual mode, retried in a fresh session when the executor takes no input, and ended stuck once nudges run out.
